doc.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Marriage, family and haggling over pay
summary: His second marriage to a Swedish wife, plans for kids, and constant negotiating.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Not yet, no. Actually this is my second marriage. So this time around I’m going to have some kids yeah. My wife is from Sweden. I met her on a job over there.

Yeah. We’re going to get a place there, keep a place in New York, and probably raise the kids in Sweden because it’s an easier place to do that. But yeah you have to be kind of business savvy. Because it’s a constant game, too. It’s one of the only jobs, maybe you’ll tell me that yours is like this, I don’t know, but it’s one of the only jobs where every single time you agree to do something, they’re trying to negotiate down and you’re trying
to go up. Always haggling. It’s a constant game of how much you can get, how much they’re prepared to pay.
